x-e-m2-05.title: Bhala kabusha isimangalo sokuthi ukuya emtapweni wolwazi kaningi kukhuphula amamaki
x-e-m2-05.goal: Isikhathi ngasinye lapho kudalulwa idatha entsha, nquma futhi ukuthi ungaqiniseka kangakanani ngesimangalo, bese ubhala kabusha umusho wokugcina.
x-e-m2-05.material: Umbhali we-blog ufuna ukubhala lokhu: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' Ake sihlole lo musho ngedatha.
x-e-m2-05.prereq.0: Funda imisho elula yesiNgisi (average, score, library visits)
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.prompt: Idatha idalulwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Esinyathelweni ngasinye, khetha isahlulelo esifaneleke kakhulu usebenzisa kuphela lokho okwaziwa kuze kube manje.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.hint.0: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, hlola ukuthi ulwazi olusha lusekela isahlulelo sangaphambilini noma luyasidudulisa.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi 'ukuguquka ndawonye' kuhluke kanjani ku-'ukuguquka ngenxa yalokho'.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kuthiwani ngokubhala 'Library visits make scores go up' ngale datha kuphela?
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Idatha ibonisa kuphela ukuthi izinto ezimbili ziyahambisana. Asikwazi ukusho ukuthi umtapo wolwazi uyimbangela.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kufakaziwe ukuthi umtapo wolwazi ukhuphula amamaki.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ukuya emtapweni wolwazi namamaki kuyahambisana, kodwa asazi ukuthi kungani.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Lesi sahlulelo sihlukanisa ubudlelwano bokuhambisana nembangela.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ukuya emtapweni wolwazi akunakho ukuhlobana namamaki.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Idatha ibonisa ukuthi kukhona ubudlelwano. Ukusho ukuthi abukho kuphambene nedatha.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Isahlulelo sakho siguquka kanjani uma lolu lwazi lwengezwa?
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Uma abafundi abaya kaningi benemikhuba eminye, kuba nzima ukuhlukanisa ukuthi umtapo wolwazi noma leyo mikhuba ibangela umehluko wamamaki.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ezinye izizathu, ezifana nomsebenzi wasekhaya nokulala, zingachaza kokubili amamaki nokuya.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Lesi sahlulelo sicabangela ithuba lezinye izincazelo.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Sekucacile nakakhulu ukuthi umtapo wolwazi uyimbangela.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ulwazi olusha esikhundleni salokho lwengeza ezinye izincazelo.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ulwazi olusha alubaphikisi idatha yokuqala. Lwandisa nje incazelo.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Uzolihlola kanjani umusho wokuqala ngalo mphumela wesivivinyo?
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Iqembu elavakashela lakhuphuka ngenani elifanayo kuphela nelamaqembu angavakashelanga. Umusho wokuqala awusekelwa yilesi sivivinyo. Ungakhumbula nokuthi isikhathi esifushane siyimikhawulo.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Kuqinisekisiwe ukuthi ukuya emtapweni wolwazi kukhuphula amamaki kakhulu.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Inguquko emaqenjini amabili iyafana, ngo-1 iphoyinti. Iqembu elavakashela alizange likhuphuke kakhulu.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Kulesi sivivinyo, ukuvakasha akuzange kwenze amamaki akhuphuke kakhulu.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Lesi sahlulelo sivela ekuqhathaniseni inguquko emaqenjini amabili.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Amasonto amane amafushane, ngakho kumele siqaphe, kodwa akusekeli umusho wokuqala.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Lesi sahlulelo sivuma imikhawulo yomphumela kodwa sibona ukuthi awuyiswa isisekelo sesimangalo.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni wawungasho kuphela ukuthi 'ayahambisana'. Ngolwazi lwesibili, kwavela ezinye izincazelo, futhi ngokuhlolwa kwesithathu, umusho wokuqala waba buthakathaka. Cabanga ukuthi yimuphi ucezu lolwazi oluguqule isahlulelo sakho.
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.prompt: Bhala umusho owodwa noma emibili wesiNgisi ohambisana kangcono nedatha kune-'Library visits make students' scores go up.' futhi umbhali we-blog angawusebenzisa esikhundleni.
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.hint.0: Hlukanisa lokho ongakusho ngokuqinisekile nalokho osenganakho ukukwazi kusuka ezingcezwini ezintathu zedatha.
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ungasebenzisa izisho ezibuthakathisa isimangalo (may, does not prove, njll.).
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Umusho wakho uhambisana nazo zontathu izingcezu zedatha?

x-e-m2-01.title: Lungisa umugqa onenombolo engalungile embhalweni webhulogi yokuhlanza ugu
x-e-m2-01.goal: Thola imisho emibili yezinombolo embhalweni webhulogi engahambisani komunye nomunye, futhi uyibhale kabusha ukuze ifane nolwazi oluqinisekisiwe.
x-e-m2-01.material: Umfundi ekilasini elilodwa wabhala lo mbhalo ebhulogini yesikole. (Ungumbhalo kuphela. Umugqa ngamunye unenombolo.)
x-e-m2-01.thinking.0: Qhathanisa ulwazi olusembhalweni ukuze uthole ukuphikisana
x-e-m2-01.thinking.1: Nquma ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi oludinga ukuhlolwa
x-e-m2-01.prereq.0: Funda imisho yesiNgisi elula (izinombolo nezisho ezifana no-in total no-first hour)
x-e-m2-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa kulo mbhalo ongahambisani nezinye izimiso.
x-e-m2-01.s.s1.hint.0: Qoqa kuphela imigqa enezinombolo futhi uyiqhathanise komunye nomunye.
x-e-m2-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi yini imigqa emibili enezinombolo ngamunye ebala (phakathi kwesikhathi muni, kuze kube kuphi), futhi uyiqhathanise eceleni komunye.
x-e-m2-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 uthi baqoqe izikhwama ezingu-30 ehoreni lokuqala, futhi umugqa 4 uthi isamba sasingu-18 zezikhwama. Isamba asikwazi ukuba sincane kunalokho okuqoqwe ehoreni lokuqala. Lo mbhalo wodwa awukwazi ukutshela ukuthi umugqa 3 noma 4 awulungile, ngakho ungakhetha noma yimuphi.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.prompt: Iyiphi indlela engcono kakhulu yokuthi umbhali alungise leli phutha?
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qala uhlole ukuthi umbhalo ukutshela ukuthi iyiphi inombolo elungile phakathi kwezimbili yini.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ungathola kuphi ulwazi lokulungisa inombolo engalungile.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.o.a: Hlola izinombolo zangempela nabangani ababale izikhwama, futhi ulungise yomibili imigqa ndawonye.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.r.a: Ukubuza abantu ababale ngempela ukulungisa onesisekelo.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.o.b: Shintsha kuphela inombolo emugqeni 3 ibe ngaphansi kuka-18, ukuze imigqa emibili ivumelane.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.r.b: Noma izinombolo ezimbili ziyavumelana, uma zingamanani abalwa ngempela, ulwazi olungalungile luyasala.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.o.c: Bhala kuphela "a lot" esikhundleni senombolo, ukuze ususe ithuba lokuphutha.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.r.c: Iphutha liyanyamalala, kodwa nolwazi olusembhalweni luyanyamalala nalo.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.explain: Lo mbhalo wodwa awukwazi ukutshela ukuthi iyiphi inombolo elungile phakathi kwezimbili. Ukuhlola nabantu ababale inombolo yokuqala nokuyilungisa ibe elungile kuyindlela enobufakazi. Ukuyishintsha ibe 'a lot' nakho kugwema iphutha, kodwa kulahlekelwa ulwazi.
x-e-m2-01.s.s3.prompt: Abangani bakho bahlolile, futhi isamba sasingu-30 sezikhwama. Bhala kabusha imigqa 3 no-4 ngesiNgisi ukuze izinombolo zivumelane.
x-e-m2-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala unqume ukuthi mingaki izikhwama eziqoqwe ehoreni lokuqala, futhi ubhale leyo nombolo eceleni kwesamba esiqinisekisiwe esingu-30 sezikhwama ukuziqhathanisa.
x-e-m2-01.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi yimuphi umusho ofanelana nezisho ezifana no-'in total' noma 'altogether'.
x-e-m2-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe inani eliphelele lincane kunenani lengxenye?
x-e-m2-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe imisho yakho emibili ebhalwe kabusha igwema ukuphikisana?
x-e-m2-01.s.s3.modelNote.2: Inombolo yehora lokuqala ingaba noma yini inqobo nje uma ingu-30 noma ngaphansi.

x-e-m2-03.title: Thola uhlelo olufanele imibandela ku-imeyili yomhlangano weklabhu
x-e-m2-03.goal: Funda yonke imibandela ku-imeyili, yenza izinhlelo ezihlukene ezihlangabezana nayo, futhi uchaze ukuthi yiyiphi imibandela oyihloliwe.
x-e-m2-03.material:
Le yi-imeyili evela kuHana, umengameli weklabhu yokufunda, eya ilungu elithiwa nguMinho. Bhala izinsuku njengezinombolo: Mon=1, Tue=2, Wed=3, Thu=4, Fri=5.

Hi Minho,
Let's plan our reading club meeting for next week.
1) We meet on a weekday, Monday to Friday, but not on Wednesday (I have a dentist visit) and not on Friday (the library closes early).
2) School ends at 3 p.m., so we can start at 3 p.m. at the earliest. The room can be used until 6 p.m.
3) The meeting takes two hours, and it always starts on the hour.
Please send me the days and start times that work.
Thanks, Hana
